title: Noujawaan Akbare Man
body:
Naujawan Akber E Maan Aaram E Jaan Akber E Maan Me Rasad
Khuskh Lab E Shaat E Furat Akber E Maan
Seelaani Makun Aayi Chasmaye Chasma E Tar E Maan
1. Kaswat E Umr E Tu Ta Aaein Qam E Feroza Namoon Laali
Aworada Baroon
Geeyti Az Neel E Aza Karda Siyaha Maujeza Maan Naujawan......
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Taa Abad Dagh E Tou Aayi Zada'ye Azad Nihaad Natawan Barda
Ziyaad
Az Azal Kaash Nami Zada Mara Madar E Maan Naujawaan...
